explanation: The inherited ValueTask case accidentally selected the generic synchronous overload and awaited only Task<ValueTask>, so it never proved completion of the ValueTask body. The replacement exposes an unambiguous ValueTask API and observes actual completion. The Task case now uses deterministic coordination and a state assertion instead of a delay without assertions. The constructor gap is closed for both concurrency and bounded-capacity limits. Greenfield hardening also verifies result overloads, maximum concurrency, bounded backpressure, queued cancellation, unwrapped delegate faults, Push drain semantics, idempotent disposal, post-disposal rejection, and null-delegate validation.
